title: Origin story: Urashima Taro
description: Urashima Taro was a fisherman who rescued a turtle being tormented by children — the turtle was Otohime, princess of the Dragon Palace. He lived with her beneath the sea in what felt like days, and returned home to find three hundred years had passed, given only a box he must never open.
